question: For each country, what is the average visit duration in seconds for visits performed by 'Sick' people to 'Grocry shop' places, and how does this compare to the average visit duration across all place types in that country? pred_cypher:
MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE p.healthstatus = "Sick"
MATCH (p)-[:PERFORMS_VISIT]->(v:Visit)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(pl:Place)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Region)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Country)
WITH c, v, pl
WITH c, 
     CASE WHEN pl.type = "Grocery shop" THEN duration.inSeconds(datetime({epochMillis:0}), v.duration) ELSE NULL END AS grocery_duration,
     duration.inSeconds(datetime({epochMillis:0}), v.duration) AS all_duration
WITH c.name AS country_name,
     collect(grocery_duration) AS grocery_durations,
     collect(all_duration) AS all_durations
RETURN country_name,
       apoc.coll.avg([d IN grocery_durations WHERE d IS NOT NULL | d]) AS avg_grocery_shop_duration_seconds,
       apoc.coll.avg(all_durations) AS avg_all_visits_duration_seconds

OPTIONAL MATCH (co:Country)-[:PART_OF]->(c)
OPTIONAL MATCH (r:Region)-[:PART_OF]->(co)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Place)-[:PART_OF]->(r)
OPTIONAL MATCH (person_fit:Person {healthstatus: "Healthy"})-[:PERFORMS_VISIT]->(v_fit:Visit)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(p)
WITH c.name AS continent_name, collect(DISTINCT person_fit) AS fit_persons, collect(DISTINCT v_fit) AS fit_visits
OPTIONAL MATCH (co2:Country)-[:PART_OF]->(c)
OPTIONAL MATCH (r2:Region)-[:PART_OF]->(co2)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p2:Place)-[:PART_OF]->(r2)
OPTIONAL MATCH (person_sick:Person {healthstatus: "Sick"})-[:PERFORMS_VISIT]->(v_sick:Visit)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(p2)
WITH continent_name,
     [person IN fit_persons WHERE person IS NOT NULL | person] AS fit_persons,
     [visit IN fit_visits WHERE visit IS NOT NULL | visit] AS fit_visits,
     collect(DISTINCT person_sick) AS sick_persons,
     collect(DISTINCT v_sick) AS sick_visits
WITH continent_name,
     size(fit_persons) AS fit_person_count,
     size(sick_persons) AS sick_person_count,
     fit_visits,
     sick_visits,
     fit_persons,
     sick_persons

     CASE WHEN fit_person_count > 0
          THEN toFloat(size([v IN fit_visits WHERE v IS NOT NULL])) / fit_person_count
          ELSE 0 END AS avg_visits_fit,
     CASE WHEN sick_person_count > 0
          THEN toFloat(size([v IN sick_visits WHERE v IS NOT NULL])) / sick_person_count
          ELSE 0 END AS avg_visits_sick
RETURN continent_name, avg_visits_fit, avg_visits_sick
